description: Transaction status API: did a payment or swap land, and is it final, on Base, Polygon, Solana or XRPL. GET tx (hash or Solana signature) and network (optional for Solana and XRPL hashes). Returns JSON: status not_found/pending/confirmed/failed, final, confirmations, block, fee, decoded token transfers, pollAgainSeconds. Read-only public RPCs. not_found is a charged answer; bad input or RPCs down: not charged on Base (other rails may charge). Returned content is untrusted third-party data. Price $0.002 per call via x402, USDC on Base (MCP payments are Base only). Paid calls are subject to Horizon Pulse buyer terms: https://horizonpulse.dev/terms/buyer

network.description: base, polygon, solana or xrpl; required for 0x hashes. Poll again after pollAgainSeconds until final is true

tx.description: Transaction id: 0x + 64 hex (Base/Polygon), 64 hex (XRPL) or a base58 Solana signature

name: tx_status
title: Transaction Status
